name: Head of Bangalash
summary: The Head of Bangalash is the trophy Hemet Nesingwary seeks in Stranglethorn Vale. It marks the final hunt in his pursuit of the great white tiger.

sections.title: The Great White Tiger
sections.body: Hemet Nesingwary has hunted King Bangalash for a long while. After the hunts for Sin'Dall, Bhag'thera, and Tethis, the great white tiger is the prize he still seeks. The tiger's head proves the hunt is done.

faq.q: Who wants the Head of Bangalash?
faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary wants the Head of Bangalash as the prize of his hunt for King Bangalash.
King Bangalash is a great white tiger in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why does Hemet want the head?
faq.answer: Hemet has pursued King Bangalash for a long while and calls the tiger the true prize of the hunt.
Hemet names Sin'Dall, Bhag'thera, and Tethis among the earlier hunts before King Bangalash.

angles.text: As a hunter, Hemet's pursuit of King Bangalash is a measure of skill in hunting and tracking.
